The main takeaway from our work is that

NESTs and NNEST teachers differ significantly in their OCF practices and that these differences are mainly due to their different cultural and educational backgrounds and the effect of their teaching experiences and teacher training programs on their OCF practices.
OCF is a highly complex and multifaceted phenomenon and that it should be approached with a fine grained analysis of the context specific factors.
